bad.address_hash_retention_days: Keep it for a whole number of days, or 0 to keep it forever.
bad.ai_crawlers: An AI-crawler policy is one of allow, block-training, block-all.
bad.base_url: The base URL has to be an absolute http:// or https:// URL.
bad.category_base: The tag base and the category base have to be different words.
bad.comment_email_retention_days: Keep it for a whole number of days, or 0 to keep it forever.
bad.comments_close_after_days: Comments close after a whole number of days, or 0 for never.
bad.contact_email: A contact address is an email address, such as hello@example.com, or empty for the first admin with one.
bad.contact_message_retention_days: Keep it for a whole number of days, or 0 to keep it forever.
bad.content_signal_ai_input: A content signal is yes, no, or not said.
bad.content_signal_ai_train: A content signal is yes, no, or not said.
bad.content_signal_search: A content signal is yes, no, or not said.
bad.feed_update_frequency: Polls per period is a whole number, 1 or more.
bad.feed_update_period: An update period is one of hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, yearly.
bad.homepage: A homepage is the slug of one of the site's pages, such as about.
bad.icon: The site icon has to be a file in the media library, a path such as /uploads/2026/10/icon.png.
bad.language: That is not a language tag, such as en, en-GB or pt-BR.
bad.license: Choose a license from the list.
bad.locale: That is not a locale, such as en-US, fr-CA or pt-BR, or empty for the language.
bad.location_sharing: Location sharing is one of none, place, exact.
bad.mail_from_address: A From address is an email address, such as blog@example.com, or empty for the default.
bad.mail_provider: A mail provider is one of none, brevo, smtp.
bad.mail_reply_to: A reply-to is an email address, such as hello@example.com, or empty to reply to the From address.
bad.notify_server: A notify server is an absolute http:// or https:// URL, or empty for none.
bad.posts_per_page: Posts per page has to be a whole number of one or more.
bad.relays: A relay is its inbox as an absolute http:// or https:// URL, one per line. "ftp://relay.example/" is not one.
bad.robots_rules: "Nonsense here" is not a robots.txt rule. A rule is a field such as User-agent, Allow or Disallow, a colon and a value.
bad.security_contacts: A security contact is an email address, an https:// URL or a tel: number, one per line. "nobody" is not one.
bad.security_languages: Preferred languages are language tags separated by commas, such as en, fr, or empty for none.
bad.security_policy: A security policy is an https:// URL, or empty for none.
bad.tag_base: The tag base and the category base have to be different words.
bad.theme: "../elsewhere" is not a theme name: a theme is one directory inside the themes directory.
bad.timezone: That is not an IANA time zone name, such as Europe/London.
bad.title: The site needs a title.
